name: Slaying the Beast
summary: Neeru Fireblade sends Horde adventurers from Orgrimmar into Ragefire Chasm to hunt Taragaman the Hungerer. He says Warchief Thrall ordered the hunt and asks for the felguard’s heart as proof the demonic cult has fallen.

sections.title: A Threat Beneath the City
sections.body: Ragefire Chasm runs beneath Orgrimmar’s red earthen streets. Its fiery fissure shelters troggs, beasts, and covert Searing Blade agents. In the Cleft of Shadow above, Neeru Fireblade claims to serve Thrall and cleanse the demonic rot. He points to Taragaman the Hungerer, a massive felguard in the cavern’s heart, and calls him the mastermind behind the cult beneath the city.

sections.title: The Warlock's Deception
sections.body: Neeru Fireblade praises those who return with Taragaman’s heart and promises Thrall will be appeased. But Taragaman is only an expendable brute, not the cult’s true leader. Neeru sends Horde heroes after the demon to give Thrall a visible victory and quiet his suspicions. The hunt shields the Searing Blade’s real leadership and deeper operations beneath Orgrimmar from closer scrutiny.

faq.answer: Taragaman the Hungerer is a powerful felguard on a rocky platform in the heart of Ragefire Chasm. Neeru Fireblade names him as the leader of the Searing Blade cultists beneath Orgrimmar.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Slaying the Beast?
faq.answer: Neeru Fireblade gives the assignment from his tent in the Cleft of Shadow, Orgrimmar’s cavernous warlock quarter.

faq.q: Why does Neeru want Taragaman's heart?
aliases: why does neeru want the heart
faq.answer: Neeru says Taragaman’s heart will prove to Warchief Thrall that the demonic threat beneath Orgrimmar has been destroyed.

faq.q: Is Taragaman actually the leader of the Searing Blade?
faq.answer: Neeru Fireblade names Taragaman as the Searing Blade’s leader. Taragaman is a formidable felguard among the cultists in Ragefire Chasm’s heart.
Taragaman the Hungerer is on a rock platform surrounded by lava in Ragefire Chasm’s middle reaches, among Searing Blade cultists.

faq.q: How does this quest connect to Hidden Enemies?
faq.answer: Thrall investigates the Shadow Council’s infiltration of Orgrimmar and watches Neeru Fireblade closely. Neeru offers the hunt to show Thrall visible results against the Searing Blade.

angles.text: As a warlock working from the Cleft of Shadow alongside Neeru, you see the political strain of practicing fel magic under Thrall’s watchful gaze.
As a member of the Horde, you face an immediate threat to Orgrimmar’s safety from the demonic presence beneath the capital.
As an orc striving to escape the legacy of the demon blood curse, you may find the felguard and demon cult beneath Thrall’s throne an intolerable disgrace.
